title: POLICY ENDORSEMENT E-17  |  HEALTH GOLD
text: Air ambulance transfer to the nearest network hospital is covered up to INR 2.5 lakh per policy year when the treating doctor advises it in writing.
question: Is air ambulance covered for Health Gold?

title: POLICY ENDORSEMENT E-22  |  MOTOR GOLD
text: Replacement of lost or stolen car keys, including the lock reset, is covered up to INR 15,000 once per policy year. A police report is required for stolen keys.
question: Is car key replacement covered for Motor Gold?
